scope: Real Next.js UI and middleware; synthetic session and intercepted API fixtures; no live database writes or AI requests.
checks: Five-step scratch onboarding, required fields, back navigation, manual review and explicit persistence; student reaches 100% without work history.
AI suggestion shows source and editable proposal; accepting changes only the draft until explicit save.
TXT upload merges non-destructively, allows corrections, requires review confirmation and persists only on Save.
409 conflict preserves the local draft; discard restores the saved snapshot.
Import and AI failures leave editable information intact.
Legacy /profil redirects to central profile and persisted information reloads.
12 profile layouts: FR/EN, light/dark, 375/768/1440 px; all fields labelled and no horizontal page overflow.
Middleware redirects unauthenticated profile access to login.
